PP1 · Chapter 6 of 6

What comes next?

Say the repeating group aloud and continue a picture pattern.

  1. See it
  2. Try it
  3. Practise it
  4. Print it
  5. Check it

This chapter works best after Where is it?. You can still look around, or jump to the check.

By the end I can…

  • I can continue a picture pattern.
  • I can find a missing picture.
  • I can notice how a pattern grows.

1 See it

Screen 1 of 4

Say it and repeat

Star, heart, star, heart.

The group repeats.

Say it out loud as you point.

Screen 2 of 4

What comes next?

Ball, apple, ball, apple, ball.

What comes next?

The apple comes next.

Screen 3 of 4

Find the missing picture

One picture is hidden.

Say the pattern: fish, ball, fish, ball.

The hidden one is a ball.

Screen 4 of 4

A pattern that grows

Some patterns grow.

1, 2, 3, 4. Each step adds one more.

The next number is 5.

Words to know
pattern
Pictures that repeat again and again.
next
The one that comes after.
missing
The one that is not there. Find it.

For parents

What your child learns

Your child sees that some things repeat in a group, says the group aloud, and finds what comes next. Patterns are the first step to algebra.

A common slip

Guessing without saying the whole group. Always say the pattern from the start, then point at each picture.

5-minute home activity: Beads and blocks

  1. Line up red and blue blocks: red, blue, red, blue.
  2. Ask your child to say it and add the next block.
  3. Try a new group like red, red, blue.
  4. Hide one block and ask which colour is missing.
